en.title: 7 Movies Like 'The Love Hypothesis' to Stream Now
en.summary: From fake relationships to academic rivals, dive into these 7 films that capture the charming chaos of 'The Love Hypothesis.'
en.body:
## 1. The Hating Game
This enemies-to-lovers gem, based on Sally Thorne's novel, perfectly channels the workplace rivalry and undeniable chemistry that made 'The Love Hypothesis' so captivating. Lucy Hale and Austin Stowell spar hilariously as ambitious executive assistants who find their animosity heating up.

## 2. Set It Up
If you loved the fake-dating trope in 'The Love Hypothesis,' you'll adore this charming Netflix original. Two overworked assistants (Zoey Deutch and Glen Powell) conspire to set up their demanding bosses, only to find themselves falling for each other amidst the matchmaking.

## 3. The Proposal
Sandra Bullock and Ryan Reynolds deliver an iconic fake-dating scenario in this 2009 comedy. Bullock plays a pushy editor who forces her assistant to marry her to avoid deportation, leading to unexpected sparks and genuine feelings.

## 4. 10 Things I Hate About You
While not strictly a workplace romance, this teen classic, inspired by Shakespeare's 'The Taming of the Shrew,' features a similar dynamic of reluctant attraction and witty banter. Heath Ledger's unforgettable performance as Patrick Verona wooing Kat Stratford (Julia Stiles) is pure cinematic magic.

## 5. The Wedding Date
This 2005 rom-com taps into the 'fake relationship' trope with a delightful twist. Debra Messing hires Dermot Mulroney to pose as her boyfriend at her sister's wedding, leading to awkward encounters and undeniable chemistry.

## 6. Green Card
This 1990 film offers a charming take on a marriage of convenience, much like the premise that drives 'The Love Hypothesis.' Gérard Depardieu and Andie MacDowell enter into a marriage for a green card, only to discover real love blossoming between them.

## 7. Holidate
For those who enjoyed the evolving relationship and the slightly awkward journey of 'The Love Hypothesis,' this 2020 Netflix film is a treat. Emma Roberts and Luke Bracey agree to be each other's plus-ones for a year of holidays, navigating their evolving feelings through various festive celebrations.

Bottom Line: Get ready for more witty banter, fake-outs, and swoon-worthy moments with these fantastic rom-coms.

content_raw: If you loved The Love Hypothesis , chances are you're here for more than just a cute love story. Ali Hazelwood's bestselling novel has all the ingredients of an irresistible romcom: forced proximity, a brooding leading man, a sunshine heroine focused on her career, and a fake-relationship that becomes considerably more complicated as the characters start catching real feelings. Thankfully, Hollywood has been mining that particular formula for decades.
